tips:
Main card: Nubank Conta Global (runs on Wise). Convert reais into the local currency in the app, then spend that balance abroad with no extra fee per purchase.
IOF is charged once, when you convert. Check the rate the app shows before converting.
Convert a few days' worth at a time, so you don't end up holding money in a country you've left.
If you pay in a currency you don't hold, the card converts automatically from another balance. Check the app for that rate.
Cash: withdraw with the Conta Global debit card. Check the app for the free withdrawal limit and the fee after it.
Don't use a credit card at ATMs: that's a cash advance, with fees and interest from day one.
When a card machine or ATM offers to charge you in reais, decline. Always pay in the local currency.
Backup: a second card on another network and about US$200 in cash, kept apart from your wallet.
